last_verified_done: PR #117 merged after the 2026-09-19 iPhone Web Core Experience retest failed discoverability. The failure was specific: the player could not tell where to tap or what each control did; Management showed 設備Project 0/4 without an actionable route; and the bottom BALANCED / INBOUND / SHIP policy controls were interpreted as staffing changes. PR #117 fixes only that layer: all five warehouse Zone labels now advertise タップ and pressure state; the first FTUE inspection can mark the actual stressed Zone as ここをタップ without revealing the equipment answer; Management Overview now exposes five tappable Zone routes; Rank 1 Warehouse Expansion keeps all four structural Project routes visible and completed routes stay visible as 完了; Rank 1 hides the ambiguous logistics-policy controls, while Rank 2+ labels them 均等運用 / 入荷優先 / 出荷優先. Godot CI #284, iOS Export Smoke #100, Rendered Visual Capture #82, Android Export Smoke #96 all succeeded. Fresh rank1_management_navigation.png at 390x844 was human-inspected: five Zone routes, all four Project routes, and the Expansion condition are visible in the same Management screen.
blocked: No Mac-independent implementation blocker for Vertical Slice v2. Native physical-iPhone DEVICE_VALIDATION remains deferred until Mac/Xcode access becomes available, but it is not the current active-phase blocker.
next: Re-run the iPhone Web Core Experience playtest on the current engineering preview, focusing first on discoverability before judging deeper reward/decision quality. From a fresh/representative Rank 1 state, verify that the player can identify tappable warehouse Zones without explanation, reach a structural Project from either the warehouse or Management, correctly understand that Rank 2+ 均等運用 / 入荷優先 / 出荷優先 are logistics policies rather than staffing controls, and understand why Warehouse Expansion is blocked. If discoverability passes, continue the same session into ghost→commit→physical change→measurement and Rank 2 STORAGE/PACKING trade-off judgment. Remain in VERTICAL_SLICE until this human retest passes.
greenlight_after_device_validation: Record GO / HOLD / KILL with evidence. PRODUCTION_DECISION remains UNDECIDED until this GREENLIGHT decision.
